title: UAAP: UST girls secure Final 4 spot; NUNS assured of twice-to-beat

blocks.text: University of Santo Tomas is the second team to clinch a semifinals spot in the UAAP Season 89 girls' volleyball tournament after the Junior Golden Tigresses swept UP Integrated School, 25-14, 25-15, 25-14, on Sunday at the Blue Eagle Gym.
